abilities.text: Crackle with Power deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.

xPrompt.title: Crackle with Power: choose X

prompt.title: Crackle with Power: choose targets
prompt.instruction: Choose up to X targets (any target: creatures, players or planeswalkers).
